title: Share one hardened local-read module across scripts
body: Outcome: one shared module for hardened local reads (open with O_NOFOLLOW and verify the opened fd path through /proc/self/fd, read through a fixed bounded buffer, list a directory through its verified fd with an entry bound) that new scripts import instead of re-deriving. Evidence: PR #180 review attempts 1-2 (records 1.json, 2.json under .krn/runs/review-series/9042aa35…) dripped the symlink-ancestor, TOCTOU, unbounded JSON read and unbounded readdir classes for scripts/rollout-usage.ts, the same classes #173 hit in src/worker. Proof: scripts/rollout-usage.ts uses the module and its three observers stay green; the module has its own observers per class.
